hooks.name: guard-goldens
hooks.description: Refuses any agent edit under oracle/goldens/. The guard exits 2 to refuse, which blocks the tool call and sends its stderr to the agent; it exits 0 otherwise. Tested with piped JSON, including through PowerShell (oracle/tests/test_guard.py). Goldens come from the binary, never from a text edit. The matcher is an anchored regular expression naming the built-in file-write tools only, so shell commands, reads and MCP tools (whose ids, such as mcp_oracle_ledger_write, would match a plain 'write') do not start the guard. Shell commands never carried a path for it to read; the goldens manifest check covers them.
